Flow wrap display box test check update ✅️ 


 


Upon inspecting the flow-wrapped units (supplied in display packs) and the display packs themselves (supplied in cases), I found the flow-wrapped units to be well-sealed and neatly presented. The display packs are also well-sealed, with the contents neatly arranged; each display contains 24 units, and there are 13 displays per case.
